description:
## Context

The audio-tools scenario (see `research/audio-provider-routing-contract` and `execute/audio-tools-greenfield-scenario`) routes BYOK-tier requests to one adapter per external API, selected by the `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider` HTTP header. This execute item ships the starter adapter set.

## Scope

Implement one adapter per external API. Each adapter lives under `scenarios/audio-tools/api/services/ai/byok/<provider-id>/` and implements the appropriate capability interface from the plan (`STTProvider`, `TTSProvider`, or `SummarizeProvider`).

### Starter adapter set

| Provider ID       | Capability  | Auth / Request notes                                                  |
|-------------------|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `openai-whisper`  | STT         | POST multipart, `Authorization: Bearer <key>`                         |
| `deepgram`        | STT         | POST raw audio, `Authorization: Token <key>`                          |
| `openai-tts`      | TTS         | POST JSON, `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, returns audio bytes         |
| `elevenlabs`      | TTS         | POST JSON, `xi-api-key: <key>`, returns audio stream                  |
| `openrouter`      | Summarize   | Reuses BAS's OpenRouter integration pattern                           |

### Registry and header routing

- Each adapter registers under its provider id in the per-capability registry owned by the chain.
- The per-request client resolves `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider` → adapter; `X-Audio-BYOK-Key` supplies the credential for that adapter.
- Unknown provider id → `ErrUnknownBYOKProvider` (400-class, NO fallback to Vrooli/Local).
- Missing `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider` when `X-Audio-BYOK-Key` is present → `ErrMissingBYOKProvider` (400-class).
- Any runtime error from an adapter (other than `ErrInsufficientCredits`) falls through to the next chain tier per standard BAS fallback semantics.

### Canonical voice mapping (TTS adapters only)

Each TTS adapter MUST declare a mapping from the canonical voice catalog (`voice.feminine.warm`, `voice.feminine.neutral`, `voice.masculine.warm`, `voice.masculine.neutral`, `voice.neutral.default`) to its concrete voice ids. The registry validates mapping completeness at startup.

Starter examples:
- `openai-tts`: `voice.feminine.warm → nova`, `voice.masculine.neutral → onyx`, etc.
- `elevenlabs`: `voice.feminine.warm → Rachel`, `voice.masculine.warm → Adam`, etc.

Callers may override per-adapter via `voice_overrides: {"byok:elevenlabs": "Rachel"}` on the TTS request; the override wins over the canonical mapping.

## Acceptance criteria

- Adapter-level contract tests pass for each external API using recorded fixtures (or live sandbox keys where available).
- Registry lookup test: a request with `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider: deepgram` routes to the Deepgram adapter, not any other.
- Unknown-provider test: `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider: not-a-real-thing` returns `ErrUnknownBYOKProvider` without cascading to Vrooli/Local.
- Missing-provider test: `X-Audio-BYOK-Key` set without `X-Audio-BYOK-Provider` returns `ErrMissingBYOKProvider`.
- Voice override test per TTS adapter: `voice_overrides["byok:elevenlabs"] = "Rachel"` wins; missing canonical mapping falls back to the adapter default and emits a structured log warning.
- Credentials never appear in any log output (credential-redacting logger).

## Out of scope

- Adding more adapters beyond the starter set (follow-up items).
- Region-specific endpoints for adapters (each adapter uses its default endpoint for v1).
- Streaming audio output adapters (see `research/audio-provider-routing-contract` Limitations).

## Dependencies

- `execute/audio-tools-greenfield-scenario` — provides the chain, interfaces, registry skeleton, and canonical voice catalog this item plugs into.

## References

- Research: `research/audio-provider-routing-contract` (Finding 8, Finding 9, Round 3 D1, Round 3 D2).
- Plan: `execute/audio-tools-greenfield-scenario` plan.md sections 8.3, 8.5.
- Pattern reference: `scenarios/browser-automation-studio/api/services/ai/` (OpenRouter adapter in particular).
